comments.comment: This is an excellent video. I do love it,  but the one thing I think I would like to point out is the scene around the 3:20 mark where it sounds like the video is encouraging people without depression to explain depression to a depressed person. There are definitely situations where a depressed person doesn't know about depression as much as whoever they are reaching out to, but most of the time, the person dealing with depression knows much more about it than the other one in the conversation. There is a terrible habit some people have where they go into a conversation with a depressed person, thinking that they know more about it than the actual person suffering. I think it's routed in the idea that "if this person know about depression the way I do, they would have gotten over it by now," which is just another result of not fully accepting that depression is a medical condition just like a physical one. Knowing all about how diabetes works doesn't cure your diabetes
